/* Splitting coefficient library. Contains mainly of symplectic partioned Runge-Kutta (SPRK) and Runge-Kutta-Nyström (RKN) coefficients
Method declaration format: #Method#Name#Description
Method options 0: Evaluate V gradient first, 1: Evaluate T gradient first or 2: both implementations
FSAL implementation is invoked by excluding the last zero-valued c coefficient. The last c coefficient is zero for all symmetric methods
Coefficients may be assigned like c8 = c1, but arithmetics are not supported

Supported macros:
(macro 0):          provided only n d-coefficients, n+1 c-coefficients will be calculated with per-d leapfrog compositions
(macro 1): _C		fills the remaining c and d coefficients given the first s/2+1 d-coefficients of a symmetric integrator
(macro 2): _S		symmetrizes non-symmetric integrators. Increases order of odd order integrators
(macro 3): _A		alternating integrator. For separable systems, reduces cost of any integrator with same number of c and d coefficients and increases order by 1 of odd order SPRK integrators. 
(macro 4): _yX		increases order of symmetric integrators from X to X+2, or orders of non-symmetric integrators from X to X+1
(macro 5): _yX_Y	same as macro X when Y = 2 which is a 'forward-backward-forward' structure. Larger A values increases the stage count and adds more forward steps for greater robustness, e.g. Y = 4 is a 'foward-forward-backward-forward-forward' structure)
(macro 6): _eX		increases SPRK order of symmetric coefficients from X to X+4, X = {2,4,6,8,10}
(macro 7): _EX		increases SPRK order of symmetric coefficients from X to X+6, X = {4,6,8}
*/
